ranges.summary: Introduces the new server-only operations module with imports for logging, auth/access helpers, Hub service functions, v3 response builders, zod typing, and feedback-record-specific schemas/serializers.

Adds helper builders for Hub create and update payloads using explicit allowlists; create injects `tenant_id` and generates `submission_id` when omitted, while update only forwards mutable fields that were actually provided.

Defines pagination/default similarity helpers and similarity parameter validation/error mapping; adds the shared response envelope builder for paged similarity match results (including dataset echoing and cursor/minScore normalization).

Implements `listV3FeedbackDatasets`: authorizes workspace access, loads feedback directories for the accessible workspace, and returns a serialized dataset list with totalCount; maps unexpected failures to a generic problem response.

Implements `listV3FeedbackRecords`: resolves the effective tenant/dataset for read permission, builds Hub filter params plus limit/cursor, calls `listFeedbackRecords`, serializes records to v3, and returns a cursor-based success list; Hub failures are logged and converted via `hubErrorToProblemResponse`.

Implements `countV3FeedbackRecords`: resolves tenant context for read, calls Hub count with the same filter semantics used by list (ensuring count/list agreement), and returns only `count` plus dataset identifiers; Hub failures are mapped to v3 problem responses.

Implements `getV3FeedbackRecord`: resolves tenant for read permission, enforces record ownership via `requireOwnedFeedbackRecord`, and returns the serialized record; unexpected errors are handled via the shared error mapper.

Implements `createV3FeedbackRecord`: resolves tenant for readWrite, validates request body with `ZV3FeedbackRecordCreateBody`, builds an allowlisted Hub create payload, calls `createFeedbackRecord`, serializes the stored record, and optionally populates audit log fields (organizationId/targetId/newObject); returns success with HTTP status 201.

Implements `createV3FeedbackRecords`: resolves tenant for readWrite, validates the batch body with `ZV3FeedbackRecordBatchCreateBody`, fans out creates via `createFeedbackRecordsBatch` using allowlisted create payloads, collects created records, and records per-index failures with relayable detail text; returns a partial-success list response (created + indexed failures) when any succeeded, or an upstream error when none were created; supports audit logs indexed by record position.

Implements `updateV3FeedbackRecord`: resolves tenant for readWrite, validates with `ZV3FeedbackRecordUpdateBody`, enforces ownership via `requireOwnedFeedbackRecord`, updates via `updateFeedbackRecord` with allowlisted field updates, serializes the updated record, and (optionally) populates audit log with oldObject/newObject; treats Hub 404 during the update window as a forbid-style response rather than a service outage.

Implements `deleteV3FeedbackRecord`: resolves tenant for readWrite, enforces ownership via `requireOwnedFeedbackRecord`, calls `deleteFeedbackRecord`, treats Hub 404 (deleted between checks) as successful completion, optionally populates audit log oldObject, emits a log entry, and returns a `noContentResponse` (204 convention).

Implements `searchV3FeedbackRecords`: resolves tenant for read, validates semantic search inputs via `parseSimilarityFilters` (query text, pagination, minScore), calls Hub `semanticSearchFeedbackRecords` with injected `tenant_id` and normalized similarity params, and returns the shared similarity-matches response; unexpected errors are handled consistently.

Implements `findSimilarV3FeedbackRecords`: resolves tenant for read, validates similarity inputs (limit/cursor/minScore), enforces ownership via `requireOwnedFeedbackRecord`, calls Hub `findSimilarFeedbackRecords`, and returns similarity matches; if the target record has no embedding (Hub 404), returns a conflict problem with embedding-pending detail rather than treating it as authorization failure.

Adds the test module setup: imports Vitest helpers, v3 auth/workspace context/types, feedback-dataset resolution/licensing utilities, Hub service function mocks, and v3 operation entrypoints; establishes module-level `vi.mock` stubs for server-only, logger, auth, licensing, tenant resolution, and Hub service APIs.

Introduces “shared authorization + tenant resolution” tests for `listV3FeedbackRecords`, covering early returns when access is denied, 403 when the feature is unlicensed, actionable 422 when no datasets are assigned, 400 when multiple datasets exist without a specified dataset, and 403 when an explicit datasetId doesn’t belong to the workspace; also asserts that downstream Hub calls are skipped on these gate failures.

Adds `listV3FeedbackDatasets` tests asserting successful dataset listing (200 with dataset data and pagination metadata), correct auth denial short-circuiting (403 without tenant resolution), 403 when unlicensed, and an empty dataset list (200 with zero counts) when the workspace has no datasets.

Adds `listV3FeedbackRecords` tests verifying single-dataset auto-resolution to the Hub tenant (tenant_id injected, datasetId/datasetName surfaced in response meta), correct naming of the resolved dataset even for empty results, datasetId/datasetName behavior when datasetId is explicitly provided, strict response-shape rules that expose dataset_id without leaking tenant_id, and error mapping from Hub responses (429 for rate limits, 502 for unreachable/server errors without leaking internal details).

Adds `getV3FeedbackRecord` tests enforcing cross-tenant and not-found indistinguishability: 403 when record tenant differs, 403 when Hub reports 404, and identical response bodies for cross-tenant vs not-found (“no existence oracle”); also verifies 502 for non-404 Hub failures and ownership-guard refusal when a named datasetId doesn’t match the record’s tenant.

Adds `deleteV3FeedbackRecord` tests asserting readWrite access enforcement, 204 success when the record belongs to the workspace, 403 refusal (and no Hub delete call) for cross-tenant records, and the same cross-tenant/not-found “identical 403 body” rule; verifies audit log stamping with targetId and oldObject (using outward dataset vocabulary, not tenant_id), correct handling of concurrent deletes (Hub 404 mapped to 204), and mapping tenant purge conflicts to retryable 409 with preserved detail.

Adds `searchV3FeedbackRecords` tests verifying tenant injection with dataset defaults, Hub call parameter defaults (min_score), response meta including datasetId/name and pagination, trimming of untrimmed tenant values before sending to Hub, pass-through of explicit limit/cursor/minScore, local rejection of out-of-range filters with 422 (and no Hub call), and mapping Hub 503 into actionable embedding configuration messaging; also verifies empty-search returns an empty dataset-matched result rather than an error.

Adds `findSimilarV3FeedbackRecords` tests covering owned-record neighbor search (Hub call arguments include record id plus defaults), 403 refusal and no Hub neighbor call when anchor record is cross-tenant with safe response content, identical 403 bodies for cross-tenant vs not-found anchors, mapping post-ownership Hub 404 into a retryable 409 embedding-pending conflict with message constraints, mapping Hub 503 to embedding configuration messaging, and local minScore out-of-range rejection prior to retrieving the anchor record.

Adds `countV3FeedbackRecords` tests verifying count response includes dataset_id/dataset_name while suppressing record-content fields, correct Hub call with tenant_id, passing through filter parameters under Hub names, prevention of cross-workspace dataset targeting (403 without Hub call), and error mapping to 502 with upstream detail not leaked.
Adds `listV3FeedbackRecords` filter tests ensuring all provided filter fields (besides pagination) are sent to the Hub with the expected Hub parameter naming and alongside limit/cursor.

Adds `createV3FeedbackRecords` (batch) tests verifying readWrite access enforcement, per-record tenant_id injection across batch entries, all-or-nothing validation behavior (422 before any Hub batch call for an invalid record), rejection for empty batches and batches over cap (422 without Hub call), submission_id behavior (auto-generate distinct submission_id per record when omitted, and preserve a shared submission_id if provided), ignoring any tenant_id smuggled in input records, partial failure reporting by index while returning created records, tight-lipped per-record error detail for 5xx and auth failures (with user-facing generic messages), upstream failure propagation when nothing was created (503), and audit-log behavior with one audit per successfully created record (failed ones left unstamped).

Adds `updateV3FeedbackRecord` tests enforcing readWrite access, patching only caller-provided fields, dropping immutable provenance fields and derived enrichment fields from the update payload, rejecting empty patches with 422 before Hub update, inheriting create-time validation caps (text cap and byte-based metadata cap), and ensuring invalid-body responses are identical regardless of record ownership. It also verifies cross-tenant/unknown record 403 equivalence and that unauthorized updates never call the Hub; asserts audit logging includes both oldObject and newObject; maps concurrent delete (Hub 404 on update) to 403 indistinguishable from no-access; and relays Hub field-level validation rejections (400 with invalid_params) with the expected response shape.

coverageSections.label: Summarized but not assigned to a layer

ranges.summary: Adds `createV3FeedbackRecord` tests covering readWrite access requirement, tenant_id injection (ignoring any caller-supplied tenant_id), submission_id generation when omitted, 201 success with audit log stamping, and extensive validation/error mapping behavior: 422 for invalid bodies before calling Hub, 400 relaying of Hub validation details (including invalid_params), 422 for missing required value fields per field_type, table-driven checks for required value_* fields, acceptance of categorical records via value_id, mapping Hub duplicate/purge conflicts to 409 and Hub 413 to 413, local byte-based metadata cap enforcement (rejecting oversized metadata before Hub), and tight-lipped handling of Hub 5xx (502 without leaking upstream detail).
